text:
𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝗟𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗟 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦! 🔥

Donald 85 off 32 and Salt 58 added 151 as England chased 185 in 13.1 overs at Carrara. 8-wicket win, 1-1.

Who wins the 3rd T20I? 👇
#AUSvENG #Cricket

𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝗡𝗘 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝗕𝗔𝗥𝗔𝗕𝗔𝗥 𝗞𝗜𝗬𝗔! 🔥

👉 Carrara 2nd T20I: Australia 184/8, England 188/2 (13.1 ov)
👉 Aneurin Donald 85 (32) aur Phil Salt 58 (30) ki 151 run ki opening stand
👉 England 8 wicket se jeete, 41 ball bachi, series 1-1

Teesra T20I Friday ko Brisbane mein. Kaun jeetega? Comment karo 👇
